heading: Precision Oxygen Therapeutics.
lead: BHOC (Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier) is a cell-free hemoglobin-based oxygen carrier being developed for veterinary tissue oxygen support when donor blood is delayed or unavailable. BHOC Veterinary covers companion animals, wildlife and other species.
text: Formulation, dosing, safety and efficacy require species-specific evidence.
